info.title: Booking Service API
info.description: Order Lifecycle, Waitlist Queue, Multi-Currency Invoicing, Vouchers, Tickets, and AI Concierge Advice.

get.description: Returns list of bookings matching customer email or authenticated user.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records to return

post.summary: Create and confirm ticket booking order
post.description: Coordinates distributed saga: validates inventory hold, processes payment, issues tickets.

400.description: Invalid booking parameters or missing required fields

500.description: Internal server error during saga execution

get.description: Retrieves booking order, status, tickets, and payment receipt.

delete.description: Cancels booking and releases seats, returning 204 No Content.

post.description: Triggers compensation workflow to refund payment and release inventory.

post.summary: Verify ticket barcode or QR code at venue turnstile
post.description: Validates ticket authenticity and admission eligibility.

post.summary: Transfer digital ticket ownership to another recipient
post.description: Re-issues ticket with new QR code and invalidates previous owner barcode.

get.summary: List audit trail of ticket transfers
get.description: Returns transfer history for authenticated user.

get.summary: List waitlist positions for user or event
get.description: Queries active FIFO waitlist queue status.

post.summary: Join waitlist queue for sold-out event tier
post.description: Enqueues attendee in FIFO queue with automatic promotion when inventory frees up.

get.description: Returns current queue rank and promotion claim status.

delete.description: Removes attendee from waitlist queue, returning 204 No Content.

post.description: Claims reserved promoted seat before promotion window expires.

409.description: Claim window expired or already claimed

post.summary: Validate and calculate discount for promotional voucher code
post.description: Verifies coupon expiration, usage limits, and calculates net price deduction.

get.description: Composes live Frankfurter foreign exchange rates with regional tax matrix.

post.summary: Convert ticket order amount into target currency
post.description: Calculates localized price and tax in target ISO currency.

post.summary: Runtime AI event concierge synthesizing live event, weather, and budget advice
post.description: Composes catalog data, live weather, FX rates, and LLM reasoning into advice.

get.summary: Get Dead Letter Queue diagnostic health statistics
get.description: Returns counts of unrouted, failed, and pending dead-letter messages in RabbitMQ.
Paginates through dead messages trapped in DLQ queue.

delete.description: Deletes all processed or discardable messages from DLQ.

post.description: Re-injects failed message back into main transactional consumer queue.

post.summary: Simulate consumer crash or messaging failure
post.description: Injects synthetic consumer failure to verify DLQ ingestion and circuit breaker behavior.

totalAmount.description: Total final paid amount in EUR

tickets.description: Individual ticket barcodes generated for booking

status.description: Ticket validity status (ACTIVE, USED, TRANSFERRED, CANCELLED)

seatIds.description: Alternative alias for allocated seat identifiers

refundAmount.description: Amount refunded to customer in EUR

message.example: Booking successfully cancelled and refund initiated.

barcode.description: Barcode or QR code data string

valid.description: True if ticket is genuine and admission permitted

seatId.description: Specific seat if waitlisted for single seat

position.description: Current rank in FIFO waitlist queue

promotedAt.description: Timestamp when waitlist entry was promoted

claimToken.description: Secure one-time claim token provided in promotion notification

originalAmount.description: Pre-discount total order amount in EUR

valid.description: True if voucher is active and valid for order

discountAmount.description: Deducted discount currency amount in EUR

finalAmount.description: Final net payable amount after discount

rates.description: Map of currency codes to exchange rates

fallbackUsed.description: True if offline fallback rates were served

headline.example: Optimal Tier: VIP Lounge with covered seating for Coldplay

weatherAdvisory.example: Pleasant 21°C evening expected. No rain gear required.

localizedBudgetNote.description: Budget breakdown note in user currency
localizedBudgetNote.example: Total estimated cost €165.00 fits comfortably within €200.00 budget.

insiderTips.description: Curated practical advice for venue navigation and travel
example: Arrive 45 minutes early for acoustic check.
Take the Jubilee line to avoid transit delays.

composedSources.description: Data sources leveraged in generating recommendation

fallbackUsed.description: True if heuristic rule engine was used

queueName.description: Source queue name before dead-letter routing

errorMessage.description: Exception stack trace or failure cause

total.description: Total messages in dead letter queue

messageCount.description: Current number of dead messages queued

consumerCount.description: Active consumer worker threads attached to DLQ

message.example: All dead letter messages successfully removed.

messageId.description: Identifier of dead letter message to reprocess

scenario.description: Simulated failure mode (e.g. TIMEOUT, UNEXPECTED_PANIC, DB_DOWN)

message.example: Booking conflict: requested hold has expired.

retryAfter.description: Optional rate limit retry-after delay in seconds
